info.name: Public API
info.description:
API for external systems to integrate with Twind using public API keys.
Additional products may extend this document over time.

## Authentication

Use the `X-Api-Key` header with your public API key.

variable.description: Client company ID. UUID of the client company. Obtain it from `GET /v1/users/me/companies` (field `companyId`).
Contract ID. UUID of the contract. Obtain it from the `by-contract` list response (field `contract.id`).

request.description: Returns the payment authorization status, the contracts that make up the chain, and any blocking requirement issues for the given contract. In **Individual** mode the detail is scoped to this single contract; in **Subcontracting Chain** mode the whole subcontracting tree is evaluated as one unit, so `contracts[]` lists every active contract in the tree (each with its own contractor) and `issues[]` spans every contributing contractor; in this mode an expired viewed contract is always Authorized and shows no issues. When the status is not authorized, `issues[]` lists the failing requirement instances. To obtain the full requirement configuration and evidence detail for each, take its `requirementInstanceId` and call the Requirements API: `GET /v1/companies/{companyId}/requirement-instances/{instanceId}` (the API key must also have the Requirements API product subscribed).

item.name: Calculation mode
item.description:
Read and manage the client's calculation mode (Individual or Subcontracting Chain), and review its change history.

- **Configuration**: Read the current calculation mode, and update it (updating requires write permission)
- **History**: List the configuration change history — product activations, deactivations and calculation mode changes

item.name: Get the Payment Authorization calculation mode configuration

variable.description: Client company ID. UUID of the client company. Obtain it from `GET /v1/users/me/companies` (field `companyId`).

request.description: Returns the client's current Payment Authorization calculation mode. Defaults to `INDIVIDUAL` when no explicit mode has been saved.

item.name: Update the Payment Authorization calculation mode

variable.description: Client company ID. UUID of the client company. Obtain it from `GET /v1/users/me/companies` (field `companyId`).

request.description: Sets the client's Payment Authorization calculation mode. The change is recorded in the configuration history.

item.name: Get the Payment Authorization configuration change history

variable.description: Client company ID. UUID of the client company. Obtain it from `GET /v1/users/me/companies` (field `companyId`).

query.description: Zero-based page index (0..N)
The size of the page to be returned
Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc). Default sort order is ascending. Multiple sort criteria are supported.

request.description: Returns mode/activation events for the client's Payment Authorization product (most recent first): product activated, product deactivated, and calculation mode changes. Each entry includes the timestamp and the actor (name + email).
